1.1: Sha’ul, and Sila, and Timotiyos, to the assembly of the Tas’loniqim in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the Father and the Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ: Favor to you and peace from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Father and the Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ.
1.2: We give thanks to Elohim always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers,
1.3: remembering without ceasing your work of the belief, and the labor of love, and the endurance of the expectation in our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ in the presence of our Elohim and the Father,
1.4: knowing, brothers beloved by Elohim, that you were chosen.
1.5: Because our Good News did not come to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Ruaḥ ha’Qodesh and in entire confirmation, as you know what kind of men we were among you for your sake.
1.6: And you became imitators of us and of the Aḏon, having received the Word in much pressure, with joy of the Ruaḥ ha’Qodesh,
1.7: so that you became an example to all who believe in Makedonia and Aḵaia.
1.8: For from you the Word of the Aḏon has sounded forth, not only in Makedonia and Aḵaia, but also in every place your belief toward Elohim has gone out, so that it is unnecessary for us to say whatever.
1.9: For they themselves report what kind of reception we had with you, and how you turned to Elohim from idols, to serve the living and true Elohim,
1.10: and to wait for His Bĕn from the shamayim, whom He raised from the dead, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏, who is delivering us from the wrath to come.

2.1: For you yourselves know, brothers, that our coming to you was not in vain.
2.2: But having suffered before and having been mistreated at Philippi, as you know, we were bold in our Elohim to speak to you the Good News of Elohim in much struggle.
2.3: For the appeal we make does not come from delusion, nor from uncleanness, nor from deceit.
2.4: But as we have been approved by Elohim to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak, not as pleasing men, but Elohim who proves our hearts.
2.5: For we never came with a word of flattery, as you know, nor with a cloak for greed - Elohim is witness -
2.6: nor were we looking for praise from men, not from you nor from others, though we could have been a burden to you, as emissaries of Mashiaḥ.
2.7: But we were gentle in your midst, like a nursing mother warmly loving her own children.
2.8: So, having a tender affection for you, we were well pleased to share with you not only the Good News of Elohim, but also our own lives, because you have become beloved to us.
2.9: For you remember, brothers, our toil and hardship, for laboring night and day, in order not to burden any of you, we proclaimed to you the Good News of Elohim.
2.10: You are witnesses, Elohim also, how qodesh and righteously and blamelessly we behaved ourselves among you who believe,
2.11: even as you know how each one of you, as a father to his children, encouraging and comforting and bearing witness to you,
2.12: that you would walk worthily of Elohim who is calling you into His own Malḵuth and esteem.
2.13: And because of this we thank Elohim without ceasing, that when you received the Word of Elohim which you heard from us, you welcomed it not as the word of men, but as it is truly, the Word of Elohim, which also works in you who believe.
2.14: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of Elohim which are in Yahuḏah in Mashiaḥ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏, because you also suffered the same from your own countrymen as they also from the Yahuḏim,
2.15: who killed both the Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 and their own neḇi’im, and have persecuted us, and who displease Elohim and are hostile to all men,
2.16: forbidding us to speak to the gentiles that they might be saved, so as to fill up their sins always. But the wrath has come upon them to the utmost.
2.17: But we, brothers, having been taken away from you for a short while - in presence, not in heart - were much more eagerly trying to see your face, with much longing.
2.18: We would therefore have come to you, I indeed, Sha’ul, more than once, but Satan hindered us.
2.19: For what is our expectation, or joy, or crown of boasting? Is it not even you, before our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ at His coming?
2.20: For you are our esteem and joy.

3.1: So, when we could no longer stand it, we thought it good to be left in Athĕnai alone,
3.2: and sent Timotiyos, our brother and servant of Elohim, and our fellow worker in the Good News of Mashiaḥ, to establish you and encourage you concerning your belief,
3.3: that no one should be unsettled by these pressures, for you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
3.4: For indeed, we informed you beforehand, when we were with you, that we would suffer pressure, and so it came to be, as you know.
3.5: Because of this, when I could no longer stand it, I sent to find out about your belief, lest the trying one might have tried you, and our labor should be in vain.
3.6: But now that Timotiyos has come to us from you, and having brought us good news of your belief and love, and that you always have good remembrance of us, longing to see us, as we also you,
3.7: therefore, brothers, in all our pressure and distress we were encouraged concerning you by your belief.
3.8: Because we now live, if you stand fast in the Aḏon.
3.9: For what thanks are we able to return to Elohim for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sake in the presence of our Elohim,
3.10: night and day praying exceedingly, to see your face and make complete what is lacking in your belief?
3.11: And our Elohim and Father Himself, and our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ, direct our way to you!
3.12: And the Aḏon make you increase and overflow in love to each other and to all, as we also do to you,
3.13: to establish your hearts blameless in qodeshah before our Elohim and Father at the coming of our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ with all His qodeshim!

4.1: For the rest then, brothers, we beg you and call upon you in the Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏, that as you received from us how you should walk and to please Elohim, you should excel still more,
4.2: for you know what commands we gave you through the Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏.
4.3: For this is the desire of Elohim: your qodeshah! - that you should abstain from whoring,
4.4: that each one of you should know how to possess his own vessel in qodeshah and respect,
4.5: not in passion of lust, like the gentiles who do not know Elohim,
4.6: not to overstep and take advantage of his brother in this matter, because the Aḏon is the revenger of all such, as we indeed said to you before and earnestly warned.
4.7: For Elohim did not call us to uncleanness, but in qodeshah.
4.8: Therefore he who rejects this does not reject man, but Elohim, who also gives us His Ruaḥ ha’Qodesh.
4.9: And it is not necessary to write to you about brotherly love, for you yourselves are taught by Elohim to love one another,
4.10: for, in fact, you do so toward all the brothers who are in all Makedonia. But we call upon you, brothers, that you do so more and more,
4.11: and to make it your ambition to live peaceably, and to attend to your own, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
4.12: so that you behave decently toward those who are outside, and not be in any need.
4.13: Now, brothers, we do not want you to be ignorant concerning those who have fallen asleep, lest you be sad as others who have no expectation.
4.14: For if we believe that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 died and rose again, so also Elohim shall bring with Him those who sleep in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏.
4.15: For this we say to you by the word of the Aḏon, that we, the living who are left over at the coming of the Aḏon shall in no way go before those who are asleep.
4.16: Because the Aḏon Himself shall come down from the shamayim with a shout, with the voice of a chief messenger, and with the trumpet of Elohim, and the dead in Mashiaḥ shall rise first.
4.17: Then we, the living who are left over, shall be caught away together with them in the clouds to meet the Aḏon in the air - and so we shall always be with the Aḏon.
4.18: So, then, encourage one another with these words.

5.1: Now, brothers, as to the times and the seasons, you do not need to be written to.
5.2: For you yourselves know very well that the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 comes as a thief in the night.
5.3: For when they say, “Peace and safety!” then suddenly destruction comes upon them, as labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they shall not escape.
5.4: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, so that this Day should overtake you as a thief.
5.5: For you are all sons of light and sons of the day. We are not of the night nor of darkness.
5.6: So, then, we should not sleep, as others do, but we should watch and be sober.
5.7: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk are drunk at night.
5.8: But we who are of the day should be sober, putting on the breastplate of belief and love, and as a helmet the expectation of deliverance.
5.9: Because Elohim did not appoint us to wrath, but to obtain deliverance through our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ,
5.10: who died for us, so that we, whether awake or asleep, should live together with Him.
5.11: Therefore encourage one another, and build up one another, as indeed you do.
5.12: But brothers, we beg you to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Aḏon and admonish you,
5.13: and to hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
5.14: And we appeal to you, brothers, warn those who are disorderly, encourage the faint-hearted, uphold the weak, be patient with all.
5.15: See that no one renders evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is good both for one another and for all.
5.18: in all give thanks, for this is the desire of Elohim in Mashiaḥ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 for you.
5.21: prove them all. Hold fast what is good.
5.22: Keep back from every form of wickedness.
5.23: And the Elohim of peace Himself make you completely qodesh, and your entire spirit, and being, and body - be preserved blameless at the coming of our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ!
5.24: He who calls you is trustworthy, who also shall do it.
5.26: Greet all the brothers with a qodesh kiss.
5.27: I charge you by the Aḏon that this letter be read to all the qodesh brothers.
5.28: The favor of our Aḏon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏 ha’Mashiaḥ be with you. Amĕn.
